_doc: Models not to screen again. Read by My-Weird-Prompts scripts/model_scan.py --exclude-file and by the script-benchmark / script-model-scan skills. Keys are OpenRouter ids; a key ending in '/' or '*' excludes a family prefix. Values say why and when. Technical fails (any refusal, plans/003) are permanent exclusions from the round robin. Pool models are never dropped by this file in the scan; it only stops re-screening them.
